title: Book a table
subtitle: Finds a table that fits, and holds it
description: Say when, where and who’s coming. Your Sylo finds places that fit, offers the best three with a line on why each fits, and books the one you pick. It checks everything the booking will say, and asks you first if there is a fee or anything it had to guess.
asks: Table for 4 on Friday, somewhere near Nora’s? Not too loud.
A quiet place for two on Tuesday at 8.

story.title: A table for Friday, found and held
story.subtitle: Say when and who’s coming. Your Sylo holds the one you pick.

browserNote: It opens the booking pages for you.
